motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Extending an Offer for the Position of City Manager and Authorizing the Mayor to Negotiate an Employment Agreement.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to approve a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Extending an Offer for the Position of City Manager and Authorizing the Mayor and Councilmember Wright to Negotiate an Employment Agreement. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Job offer extended for new city manager
motions.summary: The council voted to offer someone the city manager job and authorized negotiation of an employment agreement; no name or contract terms were stated in the motion.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for you day to day. The city manager is the city's top administrator, so this sets up who will run daily operations once a contract is negotiated and signed.
